architecture_summary: Modular React app. Pages in src/pages/. Reuseable components in src/components/. Tailwind CSS for styling. React Router v6 for navigation. No state management library (use React context/local state).

tickets.title: Create DevOS engineering dashboard page
tickets.description: Convert Stitch screen `devos_engineering_dashboard` to React component. Extract reusable table components from design. Preserve exact layout, colors, typography. Use Tailwind classes. No hardcoded data.
acceptance_criteria: Table components reusable (headers, rows, cells, pagination)

tickets.title: Build reusable table components from reference screen
tickets.description: Implement table components from `devos_table_components_reference`. Components: TableContainer, TableHeader, TableRow, TableCell, PaginationControls. Support sorting indicators, hover states, selected row styling. Use Tailwind.

tickets.title: Set up Tailwind CSS theme and base styles
tickets.description: Configure Tailwind theme to match Stitch orange theme. Define color palette, typography, spacing. Add base styles (body, headings, links). Ensure design system consistency across app.
acceptance_criteria: Tailwind config match Stitch color codes (#FF6B35, #2D3748, etc.)
Typography scale match design (font sizes, weights, line heights)

tickets.title: Create mock data service for dashboard
tickets.description: Implement mock data service. Return data matching Stitch dashboard structure (projects, metrics, team members). Support sorting, filtering, pagination. Use MSW for API mocking.
acceptance_criteria: Mock data match Stitch dashboard content
API endpoints for projects, metrics, team members

tickets.title: App shell, navigation bar, and router wiring (src/App.jsx)
tickets.description: Implement app shell. Add navigation bar with logo, menu items. Set up React Router. Configure routes for dashboard. Add 404 page. Ensure responsive layout.
